hero.title: Creating good strides.
hero.body: A transition space for people who keep moving.

story.title: A place between where you were and where you're going.
story.p1: Tedja is a coffee shop that works as a transition space across strategic points in Bandung — serving functional food and drinks in an environment that supports your productivity and daily progress.
story.p2: Creating Good Strides represents our commitment to be a support system: a space that actively helps every individual go beyond their limits at their own balanced rhythm.
story.p3: From the first espresso in the morning to late conversations at night, every Tedja is designed to help you focus, connect and keep moving.
